mentions.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
mentions.analysis: With Ja Morant on a minutes limit, Scotty Pippen Jr. is expected to get significant playing time. He has been performing well and is a good short-term roster addition.

mentions.name: De'Andre Hunter
mentions.analysis: Hunter has been dealing with knee issues and inconsistency. He is not a must-hold player and can be moved on from if needed.

mentions.name: Jordan Hawkins
mentions.analysis: Hawkins is providing good points and threes while key players are out for the Pelicans. His role is expected to decrease once those players return, but he is a good short-term option.

mentions.name: Marcus Smart
mentions.analysis: Smart's minutes have been decreasing, and he is not trending in the right direction. He is not a must-hold player.

mentions.name: Kevin Porter Jr.
mentions.analysis: Porter Jr. is considered an easy drop due to lack of long-term value and poor performance.

mentions.name: Grayson Allen
mentions.analysis: Despite returning from injury, Allen does not have long-term value and is not a must-hold player.

mentions.name: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
mentions.analysis: Caldwell-Pope is not a must-hold player, and his minutes have been inconsistent. He can be used for streaming but lacks upside.

mentions.name: Tyrese Maxey
mentions.analysis: Maxey is playing heavy minutes and putting up big numbers, but his field goal percentage is suffering. His usage is expected to decrease when other players return.

mentions.name: Andre Drummond
mentions.analysis: Drummond had a big game with 17 rebounds and is a good streaming option for rebounds and defensive stats.

mentions.name: Caleb Martin
mentions.analysis: Martin had a strong performance and is a good short-term streaming option while other players are out.

mentions.name: Aaron Nesmith
mentions.analysis: Nesmith had a good game but is only a 14-team league option. His performance is inconsistent.

mentions.name: Bennedict Mathurin
mentions.analysis: Mathurin is not performing at a 12-team league level and is not worth holding onto.

mentions.name: Dennis Schroder
mentions.analysis: Schroder is getting significant minutes and usage, making him a valuable addition to fantasy rosters.

mentions.name: Cam Thomas
mentions.analysis: Thomas is performing well and is a top 20 player in both categories and points leagues.

mentions.name: Ben Simmons
mentions.analysis: Simmons is not getting enough minutes to be valuable in fantasy leagues, and his role is limited.

mentions.name: Noah Clowney
mentions.analysis: Clowney is not playing enough minutes to be valuable in standard leagues.

mentions.name: Zaccharie Risacher
mentions.analysis: Risacher started due to injuries and performed well, but his role is uncertain when other players return.

mentions.name: Jalen Johnson
mentions.analysis: Johnson is struggling but has potential for improvement. He is a buy-low candidate due to his expected increase in usage.

mentions.name: Ivica Zubac
mentions.analysis: Zubac is performing at a high level and is a top 20 player currently. His minutes have increased significantly.

mentions.name: Norman Powell
mentions.analysis: Powell is getting a lot of shots and starting while Kawhi Leonard is out, making him a valuable player to hold.

mentions.name: Derrick Jones Jr.
mentions.analysis: Jones has been performing well and is worth adding in 14-team leagues, with consideration in 12-team leagues.

mentions.name: Stephen Curry
mentions.analysis: Curry sprained his ankle and may miss time. Monitor his status closely.

mentions.name: De'Anthony Melton
mentions.analysis: With Curry potentially out, Melton could see an increase in ball-handling duties and minutes.

mentions.name: Buddy Hield
mentions.analysis: Hield's minutes increased significantly with Curry's injury, making him a potential add for increased usage.
